themes_detail.label: Sudden Litter Basket Collapse
themes_detail.summary: Litter basket requests spiked to 3 complaints THIS WEEK—a 2,300% increase over the 8-week baseline of 0.1 complaints per week (z-score: 8.69)—suggesting either rapid infrastructure failure or a sudden change in waste management service that has left residents without disposal options.
evidence: 3 litter basket complaints filed THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 average per week over prior 8 weeks
z-score of 8.69 indicates statistically extreme deviation
Baseline before spike: nearly zero complaints, suggesting sudden onset rather than chronic issue
reporting_angles: Contact Sanitation Department to determine if baskets were removed, vandalized, or if service was altered
Interview residents about whether they've noticed missing or overflowing baskets on specific blocks

themes_detail.label: Vendor Enforcement Spike
themes_detail.summary: Vendor enforcement complaints jumped to 3 THIS WEEK—a 700% increase over the 8-week average of 0.4 complaints per week (z-score: 3.77)—indicating either a sudden surge in unlicensed street vending or an enforcement action that residents are reporting.
evidence: 3 vendor enforcement complaints filed THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
No prior spike signals in vendor complaints over 90-day period
reporting_angles: Investigate which blocks are seeing increased vendor activity and what types of vendors (food, merchandise, etc.)
Interview residents about safety or quality-of-life concerns driving the complaints
Check with Department of Consumer Affairs on any recent enforcement operations in the area

themes_detail.label: Drug Activity Complaints Surge
themes_detail.summary: Drug activity complaints nearly tripled to 10 reports LAST WEEK—a 220% increase over the 8-week average of 3.1 complaints per week (z-score: 3.29)—representing a notable escalation in resident-reported drug-related incidents across the district.
evidence: 10 drug activity complaints last week vs. 3.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Represents a sustained shift if complaints remain elevated this week
reporting_angles: Interview NYPD about any enforcement operations or identified hot spots in Williamsbridge/Baychester
Talk to residents about which specific locations are concerning them
Cross-reference with any recent arrests or seizures in the precinct

themes_detail.label: Garbage Collection Breakdown
themes_detail.summary: Missed collection complaints peaked at 35 reports TWO WEEKS AGO—a 496% increase over the 8-week baseline of 5.9 complaints per week (z-score: 4.61)—indicating a temporary but significant service failure affecting multiple blocks.
evidence: 35 missed collection complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 5.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Signal is aging but worth checking if elevated complaints persist this week
reporting_angles: Determine if collection has returned to normal or if residents still see delayed pickups
Investigate what caused the service disruption 2 weeks ago (vehicle shortage, weather, staffing)
Identify which sanitation routes were most affected

themes_detail.label: Construction Activity Acceleration
themes_detail.summary: Building permit filings totaled 504 in the last 90 days (317 alterations, 117 new buildings), and general construction/plumbing complaints doubled to 13 reports LAST WEEK—a 100% increase over the 6.5 weekly average (z-score: 3.25)—suggesting significant concurrent construction disruption across the district.
evidence: 504 building permits filed in last 90 days; 317 are alterations (high volume)
13 construction/plumbing complaints last week vs. 6.5 weekly average (100% spike, z-score: 3.25)
Active ULURPs filed: 3901 White Plains Road Rezoning and Wakefield Village development
reporting_angles: Map the 504 permits filed to identify construction clusters or neighborhoods most affected
Check on status of two active ULURP applications and whether they are driving resident complaints
Interview residents on noise, street access, and dust issues from concurrent projects
